svg.title: Project 1 of 2: Data-Generator. A fully fictional Polish online shop in 15 linked tables, from orders, reviews and the prices of five competitors to web sessions, returns and A/B tests. Truth columns, down to the true churn date, let you check your analysis, and 75 realism criteria pass. Practise: sales forecasting, cohorts and churn, market basket, campaign ROAS, cancellations, ratings, price index, A/B tests. Stack: Python, pandas, NumPy, Dash, Plotly. Animated preview: its web app (Dash) scrolls from the parameters through the data preview to the charts. Link below the card: View project.
